scope: Six original worked cases and twelve fully solved exercises: structural supply-demand identification and invariant interventions, minimum-distance pseudo-truth and extrapolation, simulation coupling and finite-atom simulated likelihood, indirect inference with shared covariates and nonregular boundaries, verified infinite-horizon dynamic choice and numerical certificates, and complete equilibrium/selection sets.

resolved_findings.issue: The old dynamic wording said current shocks were independent of future transitions, although the current action selected using those shocks determines the next state.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final contract specifies independent fresh shocks conditional on past information/current predetermined state, observation of both current shocks before action, unobserved future shocks and the deterministic action-to-next-state map.
resolved_findings.peer_assessment: Resolved; this is the correct information structure for the stated Bellman expectation and admissible policies.
